viewing_check: Estimate 30-40, current bid $20. Check for a maker label or stamp underneath (G-Plan, Parker, Chiswell, Fler) and whether top is solid teak or veneer, any ring marks, wobble in the U-shaped legs. Unmarked Astro-style tables sold on AU eBay about $75-285 (Parker ones $89-105); genuine G-Plan Astro in the UK $200-875 but those have glass tops and the maker label. Bulky, pickup only. Prices were flat to slightly rising 2024-2026.
